basic_info.description: Now offered with a $30k PRICE REDUCTION, this beautifully appointed 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom condominium is your chance to own in the heart of San Francisco's vibrant South Beach district.     Located at 88 Townsend St #119, this stylish residence features crown molding, custom window coverings, designer lighting, stainless steel appliances, and newly refurbished hardwood flooring. The spacious private outdoor patio offers direct access to a serene exterior courtyard-perfect for entertaining or relaxing.    Additional highlights include an in-unit washer/dryer and deeded parking, all within a secure, well-maintained building.    Enjoy unbeatable walkability to Oracle Park, the Ferry Building Farmer's Market, Momo's, Town's End Brunch, Chase Center, Safeway, Blue Bottle, Lucky Strike, Kaiyo, and much more. With easy access to public transit, MUNI, Caltrain, and highways 280,80, and 101, this location offers seamless city living.    Don't miss this incredible opportunity-schedule your showing today!
